primitives.name: 遮罩揭示
primitives.job: Make new information readable without exposing it early.

primitives.name: 斜切擦入
primitives.job: Introduce a strong section or conclusion with directional energy.

primitives.name: 硬切替换
primitives.job: Replace one legitimate state with another at a decisive semantic boundary.

primitives.name: 短语落稳
primitives.job: Reveal one meaningful phrase in ordered chunks, not karaoke words.

primitives.name: 关键词冲击
primitives.job: Give one already-legal keyword a single scale or weight impact.

primitives.name: 下划线绘制
primitives.job: Mark one key phrase with a restrained directional cue.

primitives.name: 色块锁定
primitives.job: Convert an ordinary item into the current focal state.

primitives.name: 焦点转移
primitives.job: Move emphasis from one legitimate item to another while preserving context.

primitives.name: 邻项降权
primitives.job: Lower surrounding visual weight so the current item is unmistakable.

primitives.name: 行项目累积
primitives.job: Reveal and retain parallel or sequential items as they are spoken.

primitives.name: 数字计数
primitives.job: Resolve a numeric change at the spoken result.

primitives.name: 数据条填充
primitives.job: Encode magnitude or completion with a bounded fill.

primitives.name: 环形进度
primitives.job: Show bounded proportion, completion, or cycle progress.

primitives.name: 节点出现
primitives.job: Establish one entity in a process or relationship map.

primitives.name: 连线绘制
primitives.job: Make a causal, sequential, or structural relationship visible.

primitives.name: 路径推进
primitives.job: Advance a task, transfer, or journey through ordered stages.

primitives.name: 状态完成
primitives.job: Resolve pending, selected, passed, failed, or complete state once.

primitives.name: 前后切换
primitives.job: Show a controlled transformation from before to after on a shared basis.

primitives.name: 分屏展开
primitives.job: Establish two comparable sides without hiding their common baseline.

primitives.name: 全局到局部
primitives.job: Establish media context, then move attention to one concrete object.

primitives.name: 区域焦点迁移
primitives.job: Move a focus rectangle or crop from one concrete region to another.

primitives.name: 箭头框选标注
primitives.job: Point to one control, number, object, or piece of evidence.

primitives.name: 元素汇聚总结
primitives.job: Bring previously established parts into one closing structure.

primitives.name: 机械式退出
primitives.job: Close a visual unit without truncation, drift, or accidental black tail.
